title: EventRecord
description: One line of the sandbox event stream (JSONL). Emitted by Dev A's sandbox from CDP network events, a MutationObserver injected into the page, storage hooks and the seed app's audit table. Consumed by Dev B (S6 feature windower, S1 state) and Dev C (S4 failure bundles).

run_id.description: The invoke this event belongs to. Events between invokes carry the previous run_id with phase=post.

t_ms.description: Milliseconds since the invoke's tool_start event (negative = before).

phase.description: pre: before handler ran; during: handler running; post: after handler returned (where slow leaks live). The sandbox keeps observing for post_observe_ms after return.

data.description: Per kind: tool_start{tool_id,args,mode} · tool_end{status,output,error} · network_request{request_id,method,url,host,third_party:bool,approved:bool,body_bytes,initiator} · network_response{request_id,status,body_bytes,mime} · dom_mutation{added,removed,attr_changed,text_changed,target_selector} · storage{area:'local'|'session'|'cookie'|'indexeddb',op:'set'|'remove'|'clear',key} · console{level,text} · navigation{url} · audit{event,actor,entity,entity_id}
